---
applyTo: "**/*.cs,**/*.csproj,**/*.sln,**/*.props,**/*.targets"
---


Follow the repository target framework, nullable settings, analyzers and formatting. Use dependency injection and options validation consistently. Prefer async APIs with cancellation for I/O. Use structured logging without secrets. Add tests using the existing framework. For device and EMS services, isolate transport, domain model, control policy and hosting; support simulation and safe shutdown.
